description: This file contains a TypeScript implementation of a command parser for a Mattermost plugin, including classes for parsing commands, matching command bindings, and constructing API call requests.

classes.name: ParsedCommand
classes.description: A class representing a parsed command, including methods for matching command bindings and parsing command forms.

classes.name: AppCommandParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing command strings, constructing API call requests, and managing command execution flow.

methods.name: matchBinding
methods.description: Finds the closest matching command binding for the input command string.

methods.name: parseForm
methods.description: Parses the command form based on the previously matched binding.

methods.name: composeCommandSubmitCall
methods.description: Creates a form submission call based on the parsed command.

methods.name: composeFormFromCommand
methods.description: Constructs a form object from a command string.
